BSOD Log Analyzer v1.0
======================================================================

1. What it is
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Desktop tool for reading the packages produced by Laptop Log Collector and
asking an AI model to analyse the logs you select.

No browser, no local server - everything runs inside this window.

2. Getting started
----------------------------------------------------------------------
1) Double-click BsodAnalyzer.exe
2) Point "Packages root" at the folder that holds your collected packages
   (default: Desktop\LogCollection). Use Open... to pick it.
3) Pick a package in the Package list
4) Open the "AI analysis" tab, choose logs, ask a question, press Analyze

3. Reading logs
----------------------------------------------------------------------
The left side lists the package grouped by its 10_.., 20_.., 30_.. folders.

  >   click a folder name to expand / collapse it
  all / none   select or clear every file in that folder
  [x] click a file name (or tick the box) to preview it
  .evtx / .dmp greyed out - binary, never sent to the AI

The counter right of the folder name shows selected/total, e.g. 2/4.

4. Picking what to send
----------------------------------------------------------------------
  Core logs        key_events.csv, power_settings, disk health, hardware
                   summary ... the small set that answers most questions
  Every text log   all text files (large packages may hit the character
                   limit in Settings)

5. AI settings
----------------------------------------------------------------------
Settings tab:

  Endpoint   https://api.deepseek.com/v1      (DeepSeek)
             https://api.openai.com/v1        (OpenAI)
             http://localhost:11434/v1        (Ollama, no key)
  API key    stored encrypted for your Windows user (DPAPI)
  Model      deepseek-chat, gpt-4o-mini, qwen2.5:14b ...
  Chars      per file / total, keeps the request inside the context window

Press "Save settings" after editing.

6. Errors you may see
----------------------------------------------------------------------
  API call failed. HTTP 401: ... is invalid
      the key is wrong, expired, or truncated when pasted
  API call failed. HTTP 400: The supported API model names are ...
      the Model field does not match your account
  API call failed: cannot connect to the remote server
      no network access to the endpoint (proxy / firewall)

7. Limitations
----------------------------------------------------------------------
- .evtx and .dmp are binary; use Event Viewer and WinDbg for those
- files are truncated (default 20,000 characters each)
- the AI only sees the files you ticked
